import sys


def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    n = data[0]
    values = data[1:]
    del data

    order = sorted(range(n), key=values.__getitem__)
    count_tree = [0] * (n + 1)
    position_tree = [0] * (n + 1)

    modulus = 1_000_000_007
    answer = 0
    processed = 0
    total_positions = 0
    boundary = n + 1

    for index in order:
        position = index + 1
        left_count = 0
        left_positions = 0

        cursor = position - 1
        while cursor > 0:
            left_count += count_tree[cursor]
            left_positions += position_tree[cursor]
            cursor -= cursor & -cursor

        right_weights = (
            boundary * (processed - left_count)
            - total_positions
            + left_positions
        )
        suffix_choices = boundary - position
        coefficient = (
            suffix_choices * (position + left_positions)
            + position * right_weights
        )
        answer = (answer + values[index] * coefficient) % modulus

        cursor = position
        while cursor <= n:
            count_tree[cursor] += 1
            position_tree[cursor] += position
            cursor += cursor & -cursor

        processed += 1
        total_positions += position

    print(answer)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
